integrity: Complete constructive proof and a standalone finite verifier accompany this result. No finite experiment is presented as a proof of the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: The all-tree theorem concerns membership concepts of maximal antichains, not arbitrary posets or node-labelled classifiers; the comb online rank is exact but no all-tree online formula is claimed. No independent priority or correctness assessment has been performed.
title: Flag shattering complexes of maximal rooted-tree antichains and an unbounded online gap
